insight: Raised a $250M Series D at a $4.5B valuation in Jan 2026, led by Coatue and Index Ventures.
name: Decagon
tagline: AI concierge agents that resolve customer support end-to-end.
description: An enterprise platform for AI customer-support agents that handle issues across chat, email, and voice — not just answering questions but taking action to resolve them. Its Agent Operating Procedures (AOPs) let support teams encode handling logic in natural language while engineers keep code-level guardrails. Used by companies including Duolingo, Chime, and ClassPass to deflect a large share of support volume.

modelSupport.notes: Orchestrates frontier LLMs behind its agents; model choice is abstracted from the operator.

changelog.summary: Recategorized from agent to the new support category for customer-support agents.
Insight updated to the $250M Series D at a $4.5B valuation (led by Coatue and Index Ventures), superseding the earlier $131M Series C.

edge: Prices per conversation or resolution, not per seat, and lets ops teach agents via natural-language procedures.
pros: Ops author logic, engineers keep guardrails
